acceptanceCriteria: A context packet for a subject reserves every tracked AGENTS.md (and CLAUDE.md) on the path from the repository root to the subject's directory, closest first, each with its own evidence row.
A fixture with root and nested AGENTS.md proves the nested file is cited and ranked ahead of the root file for a subject under it.
TCP-V0-008 is amended in the same change and REQUIREMENTS.tsv regenerated.
body:
Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). Observed: `corvint context --task ... --subject apps/fetfinder/components/WorkspaceProfileCardHeader.tsx` on the MeVille clone (Corvint 0.8.1 build 82) cited only the root `AGENTS.md` as governing; `apps/fetfinder/components/AGENTS.md`, the scope document in the subject's own directory, was absent from all results. Cause: `internal/contextindex/taskcontext.go:1212` fixes the precedence to root-level names and states that no other nested instruction path is eligible. The AGENTS.md convention (agents.md) says the closest file takes precedence, and Codex and Claude Code both load nested files. This contradicts invariant 3 (project-owned authority first) on any repository that scopes instructions per directory, and it will surface in V1-0019 untouched-repository validation.

2026-09-28 reviewed local outcome: Local implementation a5e9e29b is independently reviewed on codex/bug-fix-batch, bound CEM 494689566f90609650ce93f9c0355deaba697c84. Tracked subject-ancestor AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md selection, sibling exclusion, subjectless root precedence and bounded uncertainty regressions PASS; focused units, CLI, vet and locators PASS. Keyed completion and strict dogfood check PASS. Integration verified: PR #320 merged at e9a261d26bd5915e1c4a8d10519a6355b34c5946, reviewed head e09eed3a2d036341215c4537d5707939fdf7be3f is on origin/main, and all 11 CI checks PASS. Compatibility repair preserves unchanged frozen root-only output. TCP-V0-008 and REQUIREMENTS.tsv are updated; all three ticket criteria are supported by focused tests and independent review. Separate next-candidate release qualification remains pending outside this scoped bug ticket. Completion evidence SHA256 a364dc362f0527ce18e9b8931a80df610a2a1aff795ec64d26d0d952c929d73d.
